column4: cleat#2972: the emit mode is requested by TWO env vars (CLEAT_OPENAPI_SCHEMA_SIDECAR, CLEAT_OPENAPI_DOC_OUT), and the only caller that sets them is .github/workflows/openapi-client.yml own step. Nothing in an ordinary run asks for a document, so there is nothing for this test to measure: check-skips.sh case (a), a genuinely optional resource, which is why the skip is correct rather than a hole being papered over. It is deliberately NOT the fatal-when-CI shape used for a missing toolchain -- this job runs in CI WITHOUT those vars, so CI-fatal would fail it for doing the right thing. ONE KEY ONLY: an earlier version of this file also declared test-go/core, on the reading that its path ./... reaches cmd/cleat-worker. It does not -- that entry carries `dir: cleat` and runs inside the cleat/ submodule, which has no cmd/ tree at all, so the test never runs there. The budget guard is exact-count rather than a ceiling, so that line failed a REQUIRED context with "a grant covering something that is not there". Measured by name here: go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run ^TestEmitOpenAPIDocumentForTheGeneratedClientCheck$ -count=1 -json | grep -c Action:skip reports exactly 1.
